title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 5:38-42
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 5:38-42</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="38" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">You have heard that it was said</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        “An eye <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple" word-lang="greek" word-original="ἀντί">in recompense for  </char> an eye, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        and a tooth <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple" word-lang="greek" word-original="ἀντί">in recompense for  </char> a tooth.” 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        <verse number="39" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">And I say to you</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        do not resist<char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple" word-lang="greek" word-original="ἀντί">-in-kind  </char> an evil person. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        But <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">whoever</char> slaps you on your right cheek, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        turn the other <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">to him</char> also. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        <verse number="40" /> and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">to the one who</char> wants to sue you and take your shirt, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        release <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">to him</char> also your coat, 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a''">
        <verse number="41" /> and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">whoever</char> forces you to go one mile, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b''">
        go <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">with him</char> two. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="42" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">To the one who asks of you</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">give</char>, 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">And to the one who wants to borrow from you</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">don’t turn away</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
